rules.description: STARTER — verify against your applicable code before enforcing: compartment/party walls should document a fire-resistance rating (Pset_WallCommon.FireRating).
STARTER — verify against your applicable code before enforcing: slabs/floors forming a fire compartment boundary should document a fire-resistance rating (Pset_SlabCommon.FireRating).
STARTER — verify against your applicable code before enforcing: doors on a fire-separated egress path should document a fire-resistance rating (Pset_DoorCommon.FireRating).

STARTER — verify against your applicable code before enforcing: a fire-rated door should document a self-closing device (Pset_DoorCommon.SelfClosing) — a fire door without a self-closer is a common real-world defect.
STARTER — verify against your applicable code before enforcing: doors and windows on a designated fire-exit path should be flagged as such (Pset_DoorCommon.FireExit / Pset_WindowCommon.FireExit).

STARTER — illustrative threshold, verify against your applicable code before enforcing: fire compartment walls — minimum 45-minute fire resistance (generalizes the party-wall rule to every wall documenting a FireRating).
STARTER — illustrative threshold, verify against your applicable code before enforcing: fire doors on a compartment boundary — minimum 20-minute fire resistance.
